name: phosphatidylinositol-4-phosphate 3-kinase catalytic subunit type 2 beta

function.text: PIK3C2B encodes phosphatidylinositol 4-phosphate 3-kinase C2 domain-containing subunit beta. Annotated molecular activities include 1-phosphatidylinositol-3-kinase activity and 1-phosphatidylinositol-4-phosphate 3-kinase activity. It participates in phosphatidylinositol 3-kinase/protein kinase B signal transduction and cell migration.
